name: Uncertainty inequality
description: Tune a Fourier-invariant Hermite-polynomial times Gaussian test function to reduce the upper bound on A(f)*A(Fourier(f)). Three free coefficients multiply H0,H4,H8; the notebook derives the H12 coefficient to impose P(0)=0.
